paper.title: Hierarchical Floorplan-Guided Vision-Language Exploration for Embodied Question Answering
paper.central_claim: HFLEX-EQA combines hierarchical VLM planning, online scene graphs, specialized exploration modes and weak topological floorplan priors to outperform existing EQA baselines on OpenEQA/ExploreEQA and deploy successfully in previously unseen real indoor environments.

evidence.locator: IV-B source of floorplan; fixed text line 18
evidence.quote: In our experiments, we construct \mathcal{G}^{\mathcal{F}} from HM3D [ 23 ] semantic annotations in simulation and manually from known room layouts in the real world.
evidence.support_explanation: Structural semantic information is provided before exploration, unlike local-observation baselines; it is not inferred solely online.

evidence.locator: IV-C room labels; fixed text line 18
evidence.quote: We constrain the VLM to only predict classes present in the floorplan to allow the planner to relate observed rooms to the semantic room classes in the floorplan.
evidence.support_explanation: Incorrect or missing class priors can bias online classification as well as navigation.

evidence.locator: IV-C stop policy; fixed text line 18
evidence.quote: If an answer a_{t} is provided with confidence \kappa_{t}\geq\kappa_{\mathrm{min}} , it is returned as the final answer and the episode terminates.
evidence.support_explanation: Self-confidence threshold, not calibrated independent answer sufficiency verifier.

evidence.quote: For each room, at most M key views are selected from \mathcal{K}_{i} according to their relevance to q , measured as the cosine similarity between the CLIP text embedding of the question and the CLIP image embedding of each key view.
evidence.support_explanation: Harness-ranked within-episode image retrieval; per-room bound is not a fixed global context cap.

evidence.locator: IV-D viewpoint selection; fixed text line 18
evidence.quote: Each candidate viewpoint v is then evaluated according to S_{\mathrm{vp}}(v)=\lambda_{\mathrm{vis}}\rho_{\mathrm{vis}}(v)+\lambda_{\mathrm{img}}\rho_{\mathrm{img}}(v)
evidence.support_explanation: Precise geometric visibility scoring owns low-level view selection instead of language-only navigation.

evidence.locator: IV-D floorplan fallback; fixed text line 18
evidence.quote: If the current room cannot be matched to the floorplan or no path to c^{\star} exists, w(c) are set to zero and the floorplan does not contribute to the exploration gain.
evidence.support_explanation: Explicit mismatch fallback, but no systematic corruption experiment establishes robustness to incorrect connected priors.

evidence.locator: V-B dataset filtering; fixed text line 21
evidence.quote: We keep only single-floor episodes with semantic annotations to be able to generate the floorplan priors. This gives 108 OpenEQA episodes and 114 ExploreEQA episodes.
evidence.support_explanation: Filtered subset and explicit simulation denominator, not entire original benchmarks.

evidence.locator: V-B TableII ablation; fixed text line 21
evidence.support_explanation: Same-backbone leave-one-out components and same-prior prompt baseline distinguish hierarchy from mere added information; not every gain reduces path length.

evidence.quote: All methods use a budget of 50 iterations. Metrics . We report success rate (SR%), the average number of planning steps (S), and path length in meters (P). For multiple-choice runs, success means selecting the correct answer. For no-choice runs, answers are graded by an LLM.
evidence.support_explanation: Common planning cap and objective multiple-choice endpoint; no-choice judge identity/calibration not given.

evidence.locator: V TableIV physical versus replay; fixed text line 21
evidence.quote: All experiments were executed using the multiple-choice setting. The no-choice results were obtained by replaying the recorded observations, scene graph and planner history while removing the answer choices.
evidence.support_explanation: Seven representative physical cases are not fourteen independent deployments; alternate choices may change paths but replay freezes evidence/history.

evidence.locator: V-C replay robustness; fixed text line 21
evidence.quote: replaying the real-world episodes with perturbed images while keeping the scene graph and planner history unchanged.
evidence.support_explanation: Not closed-loop sensing/mapping robustness: graph and history insulated from visual corruption.

evidence.locator: IV-B information restriction; fixed text line 18
evidence.quote: Metric geometry and agent localization are not retained.
evidence.support_explanation: Floorplan privileged structure excludes exact robot location/metric map; compare fairly without pretending it is no prior.

evidence.locator: V-A model grid; fixed text line 21
evidence.quote: We evaluate GPT-4o, GPT-5.5, Gemini-3.5 Pro, Claude Opus 4.8 and Qwen 3.5-9B as high-level planners in simulation, and use GPT-5.5 for the real-world experiments.
evidence.support_explanation: Multiple-strength same-model baseline grid, but component ablation only Gemini3.5.

signatures.information: Frozen VLM sees online hierarchical graph, selected RGB memory, history, question/optional choices, and prior semantic room connectivity; RGB-D/poses/TSDF remain in low-level geometry
signatures.operation: VLM emits one of explore_room/go_to_objects/find_room with structured target; deterministic semantic/geometric planners choose reachable frontiers or sampled visibility-maximizing views; collect new observation and repeat
signatures.output: Navigation target and updated graph/visual evidence; final answer when self-confidence >=0.8
signatures.conditions: Pose/depth/segmentation adequate, graph binds objects/rooms, VLM confidence meaningful, low-level reachable-space planner reliable
signatures.feedback: Fresh images and incremental scene graph returned after low-level motion; no external answer correctness feedback at runtime
signatures.selection_rule: CLIP relevance for within-room frontiers, depth-occlusion/image coverage for object views; self-confidence terminates answer construction
signatures.selection_data: Current episode only; benchmark correctness not runtime feedback
signatures.persistence: Within-episode graph/key views/decision history; static algorithm and frozen models
signatures.later_use: Later decisions of same episode; no across-task learned edit or retained capability claim
signatures.claimed_effect: Gather missing rather than redundant evidence for EQA
signatures.failure_boundary: Graph errors and uncalibrated answer confidence propagate; illumination/view angle not in geometric view score

signatures.object: Prior-guided discovery of unobserved room classes
signatures.information: Floorplan labels/connectivity from simulator annotations or human layout; no metric coordinates or localization; online semantic label constrained to prior classes
signatures.operation: Match all same-class floorplan nodes, compute neighboring-class shortest-distance softmax toward target class, mix weighted CLIP frontier scores with transition semantics and frontier size
signatures.output: Highest-scored frontier; zero prior weight if class/path unavailable
signatures.conditions: Prior labels/connectivity sufficiently informative and room/frontier CLIP features trustworthy
signatures.feedback: Observed rooms update graph/class matching; static prior is not corrected or optimized
signatures.selection_rule: Fixed weights .35 transition/.55 floorplan/.1 size; no learned selection
signatures.selection_data: Current graph/prior; no retained selection protocol
signatures.persistence: Fixed prior for episode and online map, not a self-improving memory
signatures.claimed_effect: Choose useful unseen-room direction without exact floorplan localization
signatures.failure_boundary: Wrong but connected priors can mislead; no perturbation suite for floorplans, missing classes constrain room labels

gap.author_gap: Local-only single-strategy exploration fails to distinguish unseen-room search, room completion and object inspection, leaving floorplan structure unused.
gap.checked_gap: GraphEQA already supplies online scene graphs and relevant images; frontier semantics precede this work. Residual is explicit mode selection plus nonlocalized topological prior for unseen-room discovery, with some isolated evidence.

lineage.relation: Hydra constructs graph; LSeg/CLIP semantic maps/frontiers follow VLFM/ESC; GraphEQA precedes structured EQA visual memory; ExploreEQA active image-based planning.

gap.remaining_gap: Noisy/missing floorplan stress, calibrated stopping, mapping/semantic errors, multi-floor environments, full deployment cost and independent real-run reliability.

claims.text: HFLEX outperforms GraphEQA/ExploreEQA using structural prior and hierarchy
claims.setting: Habitat HM3D single floors with semantic annotations;108 OpenEQA/114 ExploreEQA episodes; choices/nochoices
claims.baseline/control: Five fixed backbones across harnesses; ExploreEQA supports choices only;50 planning iterations all methods
claims.selection_vs_test: Benchmark subsets filtered for prior availability; development/tuning scene disjointness unreported
claims.budget: Same high-level cap, unequal steps/path and unreported internal call/token counts
claims.result/denominator: Gemini choices75.0/63.2 versus GraphEQA46.3/54.4; noFP64.8/53.5; noVP67.6/58.8; noSF66.7/57.0; GraphEQA+FP43.5/57.0
claims.failures: No question-type/false-stop taxonomy, wrong-prior cases or LLM grader validation
claims.statistics: Descriptive single aggregate rates, no repeated CIs/tests
counterevidence: Extra annotation-derived structure; filtered benchmarks not full benchmark SOTA; hierarchy often spends more path than GraphEQA; nochoices answer judge opaque
claims.allowed_conclusion: Author-reported same-backbone gains on specified filtered subsets; isolated components and same-prior baseline support nontrivial system contribution under prior availability, not universal efficiency or unseen-building reliability.

claims.text: Successful real-world unseen indoor deployment and robustness
claims.setting: Quadruped, LiDAR/IMU odometry, D455 RGBD, JetsonThor; API VLM; hand-built floorplans
claims.baseline/control: Seven representative multiple-choice physical episodes; offline no-choice/image-perturbation replay
claims.selection_vs_test: Unseen environment claim, exact development separation and unsuccessful attempt pool not disclosed
claims.budget: TableIV steps4-11 and paths14.6-50.9m; no elapsed time/API usage
claims.result/denominator: Seven example correct answers;47/50 replay planning modes match original; total physical attempt denominator missing
claims.failures: Strong blur decreases answer success; frozen graph/history shield mapping consequences
counterevidence: 47/50 is mode agreement, not task success; replay cannot certify counterfactual closed-loop choices
claims.allowed_conclusion: Feasible physical examples and conditional replay consistency, not counted sim-to-real reliability or end-to-end perceptual robustness.

assessment.strongest_supported_claim: Authors report counted closed-loop simulation EQA improvements on filtered prior-available subsets across five backbones, with informative one-component and same-prior controls. Qualitative physical examples and offline replay do not establish counted transfer, calibrated stopping, full-benchmark SOTA or robustness to erroneous floorplans.
